jobs.title: Studentische Hilfskraft (d/m/w) im Veranstaltungsmanagement
jobs.reason: This is a studentische Hilfskraft (working-student) position, which is excluded by policy regardless of field. It is also an events-management support role, a partial skills gap, though SWP is an on-target policy institute.

jobs.title: Research Associate for the Project "Cluster of Excellence Understanding Written Artefacts" (Doctoral Researcher, Arabic Studies)
jobs.reason: The post requires an excellent Master's in Arabic Studies or a closely related discipline and fluency in written and spoken Arabic as an essential — the candidate holds neither and has no working Arabic. Although it is a funded PhD position, both the disciplinary qualification and the language requirement are unmet essentials, and the manuscript-cultures topic is far outside the candidate's fields.

jobs.title: Softwareentwickler:in (w/d/m)
jobs.reason: This is a deep-technical software-engineering role whose essential requirements — strong modern web development with React and TypeScript, backend services with Node.js/Spring Boot/Quarkus, and ownership of software architecture — are well beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python and coursework-level web familiarity. It also expects a computer-science or comparable IT degree; the digital-humanities framing does not offset the engineering essentials.
jobs.salary: Up to EG 13 TVöD Bund (depending on qualification)

jobs.title: Research Associate (Doctoral Researcher) — Cluster of Excellence "Understanding Written Artefacts", Ottoman/Turkish Studies
jobs.reason: Requires an excellent Master's in Ottoman/Turkish Studies and, as an essential, fluency in Turkish (written and spoken) — both of which the candidate lacks entirely. Although this is a funded PhD post (otherwise eligible in principle), the language and field requirements are unmet essentials and the subject sits well outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Research Associate (Doctoral Researcher) — Cluster of Excellence "Understanding Written Artefacts", Early Medieval Studies
jobs.reason: This is a funded PhD post (eligible in principle), but its essential requirement is an excellent Master's in Medieval Studies (Medieval History or Medieval Auxiliary Sciences) or a closely related discipline, which the candidate — an IR/politics graduate — does not hold. It also requires a detailed project proposal on the materiality of written artefacts in early medieval history, entirely outside the candidate's field and interests.
jobs.type: Part-time (75% TV-L E13), fixed-term doctoral position

jobs.title: Research Associate — Doctoral Researcher, Cluster of Excellence "Understanding Written Artefacts" (African Studies / West Africa)
jobs.reason: This funded doctoral post requires as essentials an excellent Master's in African Studies (or a closely related discipline) with a West Africa focus AND knowledge of a West African language — neither of which the candidate has; their MSc is in International Relations and their working languages are German/English only. However attractive a funded PhD is in principle, these disciplinary and language requirements are unmet essentials.

jobs.title: Research Associate — Doctoral Researcher, Cluster of Excellence "Understanding Written Artefacts" (Art History)
jobs.reason: The essential requirement is an excellent Master's in Art History or a closely related discipline plus a research project on the materiality of written artefacts and pre-modern book cultures — a field the candidate's IR / international-law background does not meet. Although it is a funded PhD post (otherwise eligible in principle), the disciplinary essential is an unmet hard requirement, and the topic sits entirely outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Leitung Kommunikation / Pressesprecher:in (m/w/d) in Vollzeit (ID 408)
jobs.reason: This is a department-head / press-spokesperson leadership role requiring several years of communications experience plus multi-year staff-leadership experience over a 13-person team — clearly not entry-level and well beyond the candidate's profile. Although it sits at a renowned social-science research institute, the seniority and dedicated communications-management requirements are unmet essentials.

jobs.title: Praktikant*in im Bereich Globale Gesundheit & Telemedizin: Klinikpartnerschaften
jobs.reason: This is explicitly a Praktikum (internship), which is excluded as a matter of policy, and it further requires current enrolment or a degree completed no more than 6 months prior. The global-health / telemedicine field also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.
